comment: External dependency manifest (CONVENTIONS.md section 9). requires_core is '*'
because this repo IS the core — the field exists so suite-check can parse this
repo with the same code path as any suite.
What belongs here is everything a package manager cannot see: system tools a
consumer must have before the scripts and hooks can run.

dependencies.name: python3
install: macOS: brew install python@3 (or the system python3)
dependencies.note: All lint/contract scripts are stdlib-only — no pip install needed.

dependencies.name: node
dependencies.note: The hook helpers are plain .cjs — no npm install, no build step.

dependencies.name: zsh
dependencies.note: The session hooks no longer need zsh: bootup and closing are portable bash and the settings template wires them via `bash`, verified on Windows/Git-Bash. Only scripts/brain-scan.sh still carries a zsh shebang — it is launched by a scheduler (launchd/cron), so making it portable is part of making the scheduler itself run on Windows, not a hook concern.
